about: The crypt's Pillar forest (docs/milestones/connected-biomes.md, CB13): a fight room, a floating slab of the crypt's flagstones; its landmark a forest of nine pillars in three rows, some cracked, where a shot finds cover and a dash finds a way. Its edge a broken lip (crypt_edge) and an invisible wall (its void a wall), held straight under its sockets (west, north, east, south) by pins. tools/ground_shape.py draws arena_09_ground.tscn and its art from this.
